scope: 26 eligible evidence pairs from the frozen 2026-10-14 assessment; buggy-side candidate stage

records.reference_issue: Non-ASCII traced output/source fails under non-UTF-8 default encoding: FileWriter.write lacks explicit UTF-8 and/or byte source defaults to ASCII. The paired test reproduces a UnicodeEncodeError under an ASCII locale.
records.reason: 候选是空 source、PathLike 或变量顺序问题，没有识别 ASCII locale 下的非 ASCII 编码失败；Agent 容器默认 UTF-8 也无法触发参考编码场景。

findings.title: PathLike.__subclasshook__ 对非类对象调用 hasattr 可能误判/异常
iscoroutinefunction 回退实现忽略参数，可能掩盖真实协程
source 为空列表时 source[0] 触发 IndexError

records.reference_issue: get_write_function's path writer references undefined output_path instead of the supplied output, raising NameError when tracing to a file.
records.reason: 缺陷版明确识别 output_path 未定义；生成测试实际执行 @snoop(path) 后抛 NameError，两次失败且独立对照在修复版通过。修复版候选均不再报告该引用错误。

findings.title: write 闭包引用未定义的 output_path 导致 NameError

records.reference_issue: WebSocketHandler.set_nodelay uses self.stream although the upgraded connection is held by ws_connection; valid calls from open fail the assertion or use the wrong stream. Generic assert-removal advice is not a match.
records.reason: 候选关注压缩参数异常文案或非 ws/wss URL；未识别有效 WebSocket set_nodelay 调用了错误 stream。

findings.title: ValueError 使用 %r 占位符但未做格式化

records.reference_issue: WebSocket finish clears ui helpers before the connection actually closes, breaking render_string while open.
records.reason: ETag、204/304、Content-Length 与 origin 候选不对应 WebSocket 在真正关闭前过早清理 ui helpers。

findings.title: finish() 中 204/304 断言在 -O 下被移除，可能发送非法响应体
ETag 自动生成检查使用 'Etag' 而非规范大小写，可能覆盖用户设置的 ETag

records.reference_issue: Transfer-Encoding chunked matching is case sensitive; a valid Chunked header fails to select chunked parsing.
records.reason: direct 缺陷版 61a457a1641f 正确给出合法 Chunked 大小写输入；fixed 的多值 Transfer-Encoding 候选是另一条件。evidence 只讨论负长度与空白，未找到已知问题。

findings.title: 负数 Content-Length 绕过长度校验并导致读取异常

records.reference_issue: Facebook access-token response parsing mishandles bytes/string token values; callback propagation also passes a Future as a callback.
records.reason: 缺 access_token、expires 形态、OAuth 签名和字典顺序候选均不对应字节 token 解析或 Future/callback 传递错误。

findings.title: 缺少 access_token 时 KeyError 导致回调异常而非 AuthError
expires 取值为列表而非标量

records.reference_issue: An existing Transfer-Encoding: chunked header disables _chunking_output, so write_headers/body handling can emit an invalid unchunked body or fail a redirected PUT without a body.
records.reason: 候选讨论 HEAD body、非法 Content-Length 和通用 _format_chunk 行为；没有指出已有 Transfer-Encoding: chunked 导致关闭分块输出。

findings.title: HEAD 响应仍可能设置 _expected_content_remaining 为 Content-Length 值
Content-Length 头值非数字时 int() 抛出未捕获的 ValueError
write_headers 中 chunk 参数在 chunking 关闭时仍被 _format_chunk 处理

records.reference_issue: AsyncHTTPClient.close assumes a weak instance-cache entry still exists during HTTPClient destruction; an already-cleared entry causes inconsistent-cache RuntimeError/KeyError. Do not count intentional errors for another live client.
records.reason: 没有模型候选；没有识别 weak cache 已清理后的 close 异常。

records.reference_issue: StaticFileHandler mishandles HTTP byte ranges: oversized suffix ranges leave a negative start rather than clamping to zero, or reversed end/start ranges are not rejected with 416. Either concrete failing condition counts as a case-level hit; report which was found.
records.reason: 缺陷版 3e533c03160d 正确识别 bytes=-100、size=10 导致负 start；生成测试复制了处理逻辑，没有实际调用目标方法，被判 unrelated_failure。修复版叙述承认夹紧和 reversed-range 检查正确。

findings.title: suffix range 长度超过文件大小时 start 变为负数导致 416 判定失效
后缀范围恰好覆盖整个文件时错误返回 206 而非 200

records.reference_issue: PeriodicCallback._update_next fails to advance _next_timeout when the clock moves backwards/current_time is less than _next_timeout, causing repeated scheduling or callback delays.
records.reason: 没有模型候选；没有识别时钟回拨时 _next_timeout 不推进。

records.reference_issue: IOLoop's asyncio-to-IOLoop registry retains closed loops: weak keys do not help when values keep the loop alive, and close/external close lacks appropriate deletion/cleanup, leaking loops.
records.reason: configure 类型校验、重复 close 和假设未来扩展均不对应关闭 loop 后映射保留与泄漏。

findings.title: configure() 在 asyncio 可用时对非字符串 impl 调用 issubclass 可能抛 TypeError

records.reference_issue: run_in_executor directly returns concurrent.futures.Future, which cannot be awaited by native async coroutines; it must bridge into a Tornado/asyncio-compatible Future.
records.reason: 没有模型候选；没有识别 concurrent.futures.Future 不可原生 await。

records.reference_issue: accept_connection calls _handle_websocket_headers outside its ValueError handler, so missing/invalid WebSocket headers escape instead of returning a controlled HTTP 400.
records.reason: 没有模型候选；没有识别 WebSocket 头 ValueError 位于捕获块之外。

records.reference_issue: url_concat(url, None) should return url, rather than raising TypeError.
records.reason: 没有指出 args=None；多值参数、拼接边界候选均不是官方 None 参数触发条件。

records.reference_issue: Unary match filters treat a present boolean False as true because they only test None; positive/negated boolean filters must distinguish True from False.
records.reason: 没有模型候选；没有识别布尔 False 的正向/反向过滤错误。

records.reference_issue: js_to_json string token regex omits escaped n/u, partially matches valid JS strings and corrupts the converted JSON.
records.reason: 候选误解 fix_kv 中保留反斜杠的含义，或讨论尾随逗号；未识别 escaped n/u 在字符串 token regex 中缺失的参考根因。

findings.title: js_to_json 单引号字符串转义处理错误：反斜杠转义被破坏
js_to_json 仅移除数组尾逗号，对象尾逗号未处理

records.reference_issue: str_to_int applies re.sub to non-string inputs and raises TypeError; fixed implementation returns these inputs unchanged.
records.reason: evidence 缺陷版 1f94bb5c2092 找到了有效整数输入触发 re.sub TypeError；但声称预期返回 None，与参考修复返回输入本身不同。只计症状识别，unsupported 不计证据命中。direct 两侧均未报告。

findings.title: str_to_int 对非字符串输入抛出 TypeError 而非返回 None
int_or_none 对布尔值 True/False 返回 1/0 而非 default
url_or_none 对仅含空白的字符串返回 None 但未处理 strip 后为空的情况

records.reference_issue: Negated string filter uses not str_op rather than not str_op(attr, value). Valid negation syntax is ext!=mp4.
records.reason: direct 缺陷版 093ccfb690a3 正确描述 not str_op 的根因和 ext!="mp4" 输入；但 fixed API 超时导致对照不完整。evidence 根因线索正确却使用 !ext=mp4，这会匹配普通相等运算，未进入否定分支。原测试在修复版同样 True is not false；不计严格候选或证据命中。

findings.title: 字符串过滤器取反逻辑错误：对函数对象取非而非调用结果

records.reference_issue: urljoin does not recognize arbitrary absolute URI schemes in path, incorrectly joining/dropping already absolute non-http URLs.
records.reason: 候选关注 base_url 有效性、空白、bytes 和 //path；参考问题是 path 本身已为 ftp 等绝对 URI 却未被保留。

findings.title: base_url 对不匹配的 URL 调用 .group() 触发 AttributeError
urljoin 对非 UTF-8 字节 path 解码抛 UnicodeDecodeError

records.reference_issue: DASH Representation format_id is not necessarily unique: merging/replacing entries solely by representation_id discards distinct formats or their media fragments.
records.reason: 缺陷版没有模型候选；修复版 SegmentTimeline 越界/零 duration 不对应按非唯一 format_id 丢失 DASH 格式。

records.reference_issue: unescapeHTML's entity regex allows an ampersand inside the entity body and consumes adjacent/nested entity starts, preventing the intended HTML entity from being decoded.
records.reason: 只有静态 assert 建议，没有识别 entity body 中 ampersand 吞并相邻实体。

records.reference_issue: JSInterpreter's function-call regex requires nonempty arguments and/or splits an empty argument string, so a valid zero-argument JavaScript call fails.
records.reason: split() 限制、未定义变量、splice 和 Unicode isdigit 均不对应函数调用 regex 不允许有效零参数 f()。

findings.title: splice 循环中 pop(index) 使用固定索引导致结果错误
索引赋值断言 isinstance(idx, int) 在 -O 下失效且类型不匹配时崩溃
split 断言 argvals == ('',) 对无参 split() 调用失败
函数调用参数解析对非数字标识符直接索引 local_vars 可能 KeyError

records.reference_issue: unified_timestamp fallback receives a tuple from email.utils.parsedate_tz but calls its nonexistent timetuple(), raising AttributeError; or it fails to apply the PM offset in that fallback. Generic PM/12-hour concerns outside this fallback do not count.
records.reason: 日期解析退出、隐藏文件名与一般 PM 偏移候选均没有定位 parsedate_tz fallback 的 tuple.timetuple() 或该分支 PM 偏移缺失。

findings.title: unified_strdate 循环未在匹配后 break，可能被后续格式覆盖
unified_timestamp 在循环内 return，但异常路径下可能返回 None 而非回退
subtitles_filename 对无扩展名文件名处理不当
date_from_str 对非法输入抛出未捕获异常

records.reference_issue: parse_dfxp_time_expr returns numeric zero for absent time rather than None, or dfxp2srt accesses missing begin/dur attributes without skipping invalid entries, leading to incorrect subtitle timing or KeyError. Either reference-patch failure mode counts, with trigger evidence.
records.reason: 缺陷版 b16c1ed38deb 和 32a91644c156 分别识别缺 dur、缺 begin 的 KeyError；生成格式/契约失败未形成有效证据。修复版显式 end=0 的候选不等同于缺失 begin/dur 或 parse(None) 的参考条件。

findings.title: srt_subtitles_timecode 在 Python 3 下使用浮点除法导致 %d 格式化报错
dfxp2srt 对缺少 end 且缺少 dur 的段落抛出 KeyError
dfxp2srt 对缺少 begin 属性的段落抛出 KeyError

records.reference_issue: js_to_json returns double-quoted JavaScript strings unchanged, preserving escaped single quotes (\') that are invalid JSON escapes; these strings must be normalized and re-encoded.
records.reason: 缺陷版反斜杠数量与 tab 等 regex 转义候选不是双引号字符串保留单个 escaped apostrophe 的参考错误；修复版讨论双反斜杠计数，是另一输入条件。

findings.title: js_to_json 单引号字符串中反斜杠转义处理错误
js_to_json 正则未匹配含转义引号的字符串边界
strip_jsonp 贪婪匹配可能吞掉多余内容

records.reference_issue: Format selection '/' appends a PICKFIRST selector immediately and clears current_selector, so following filters cannot attach to the fallback choice and parsing/selection becomes wrong.
records.reason: 候选都是缺选择器或缺右括号的非法表达式诊断，未识别有效 fallback 选择器后 filters 丢失。额外 reproduced 不自动算参考命中。

findings.title: 逗号分隔时 current_selector 为 None 会被追加进 selectors
斜杠 '/' 左侧缺少选择器时 first_choice 为 None
加号 '+' 左侧缺少选择器时 video_selector 为 None
_parse_filter 在缺少 ']' 时静默返回不完整过滤器
